_: james_bond_le's playfield geometry for vpxgen.py, traced from the game's
Points are in that drawing's coordinates, the same ones switch_xy.txt and
device_xy.txt use; heights are Visual Pinball units above the playfield.
walls: an open path is a wall `thick` drawing units wide along it; a
`closed` one is the polygon itself (a slingshot: `slingshot` names the
segment that kicks). ramps: `kind` flat or wire, height rising or falling
linearly from h0 at the first point to h1 at the last. A flat ramp joins a
flat one cleanly; a flat ramp into a wireform threw the ball back at the
join, so the right ramp's return is flat too. switch_surface: a
switch whose trigger sits ON a ramp. The upper left flipper points DOWN
along the left orbit's inner wall (pivot at its top, the drawing's
elongated shape at 62-70, 428-485), its pivot moved right a little so the
orbit lane past it stays a ball wide; the left eject kicks up and right.
The side ramp and the back-ramp
wireform are not built: where they start and join could not be read off
the drawing, and the side ramp's enter opto lies under the right ramp here.
